column3: Bursting Into The Room
Kyousuke-shi, if you don't calm Kiririn-shi's wrath...
E-Even if you say that...
If that's the case, 'tis the occasion for a "Two-Shot Conversation"!
A "Two-Shot Conversation"? What's that?
Venturing towards an honest one on one conversation with Kiririn-shi!
React accordingly to the other party's speech and "retort" at the appropriate time!
I-I get it. I'll give it a try...
Watch it, there's also times where you don't gotta "retort"!
What are you mumbling about? You pervert! Just die already!
C-Calm down, Kirino... This is just a misunderstanding.
Shut up! Don't deny it!
Although I tried to "retort" her, it looks like it didn't work at all.
As expected of Kyousuke-shi! A splendid retort!
Kiririn-shi's wrath softened a little bit!
Eh?! She calmed down just because of that?!
Who could understand such a thing?!
You can't even deny it?
D-Damn! I missed my chance...!
Kyousuke-shi, hang in there! "Retort", "retort"!
I know. Okay, this time, I'll definitely...
Then, did you see them?
Huh?
I'm asking if you saw them!
S-Saw what?!
You know...! That black one's... p-panties...
I didn't see them!
Liar! You saw!
It's true! We can switch positions if you don't believe me! Then you'll know I couldn't see them from here!
You tried?
K-Keep your mouth shut already!
Hmm, that so? You didn't see them...
Aren't you stupid? Don't be so misleading.
Ohhh! Nice one, Kyousuke-shi! Looks like you fixed up the misunderstanding with Kiririn-shi!
Eh? No, but I just got called "stupid"... Right?
Did I really clear up the misunderstanding?
D-Damn! I missed my chance...!
So you DID see them! Unbelievable!
...Senpai really is the worst kind of filth.
That's harsh...
I'll ask you one final question.
*gulp*
Did you bring my friends over to your room while I was gone?
I-I didn't...
Did... the retort succeed?
Then, why did those two spontaneously come into your room today?
The black one said it too: "We've always been gathering in this room".
...What does that mean? Explain yourself.
Er... Errr...
N-No, not by any means! Kiririn-shi! Heed my words!
Huh?
When Kiririn-shi took her leave, Kyousuke-shi...
...became really really lonely.
For that reason, Kuroneko-shi and I decided to raise this desolate fellow's spirits by arriving to play!
Do you understand?
...In the end, Saori covered for me.
Hmm... You... You got lonely when I wasn't around...
That's right!
But, there's a reason for that.
Huh?
Saori and Kuroneko were worried that I'd be lonely without you around.
That's why they came to play so often.
But in the end, you're still angry. Isn't that wrong?
Hmm... You... You got lonely when I wasn't around...
Disgusting... Just how much of a siscon are you...
Disgusting, just how much of a siscon are you?
